content: If you’re looking for a new laptop or a gift for the student in your life, you can save $100 on the MacBook Neo at several retailers, in both storage sizes and all four colors. The 256GB model is currently discounted to $599.99 at Amazon and Costco, while the 512GB model with Touch ID is available for $699.99 via the same retailers (Amazon / Costco). None of the retailers currently list an end date for the discount, which is the biggest price drop we’ve seen since Apple raised the laptop’s MSRP by $100 in July in response to the ongoing RAM crisis. [Product: MacBook Neo | https://www.amazon.com/Apple-2026-MacBook-13-inch-Laptop/dp/B0GR6JMY9W/?tag=theverge02-20, https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GR6F79MT/?tag=theverge02-20, https://go.skimresources.com/?id=87443X1797501&xs=1&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.costco.com%2Fp%2F-%2Fmacbook-neo-laptop-13-inch-apple-a18-pro-chip-built-for-apple-intelligence-6-core-cpu-5-core-gpu-8gb-memory-256gb-ssd-storage%2F4000447603] Apple’s budget-friendly MacBook leverages the A18 Pro processor, a chip originally found in the iPhone 16 Pro, to keep costs down. Both the 256GB and 512GB models feature 8GB of memory, and my colleague Antonio G. Di Benedetto was impressed by the vivid 13-inch screen and speakers, the latter of which are better than those in many cheap (and even midrange) Windows laptops. The Neo isn’t super performant, especially in terms of storage speed and total memory, but it’s great for everyday tasks, casual use, and students. Read our Apple MacBook Neo review. Update, November 26th: Adjusted pricing and availability to reflect the additional discount that’s now available at both Amazon and Costco.

chineseContent: 如果您正在为您生命中的学生寻找一台新笔记本电脑或一份礼物，您可以在多家零售商处购买 MacBook Neo，以节省 100 美元，有两种存储尺寸和所有四种颜色。目前，256GB 型号在亚马逊和 Costco 的折扣价为 599.99 美元，而带 Touch ID 的 512GB 型号在同一零售商（亚马逊/好市多）的售价为 699.99 美元。目前没有一家零售商列出折扣的结束日期，这是自苹果公司在 7 月份将笔记本电脑的建议零售价提高 100 美元以应对持续的 RAM 危机以来我们看到的最大降价。 [产品：MacBook Neo | https://www.amazon.com/Apple-2026-MacBook-13-inch-Laptop/dp/B0GR6JMY9W/?tag=theverge02-20，https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GR6F79MT/?tag=theverge02-20， https://go.skimresources.com/?id=87443X1797501&xs=1&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.costco.com%2Fp%2F-%2Fmacbook-neo-laptop-13-英寸-苹果-a18-pro-芯片内置适用于-苹果智能-6-核心-cpu-5-核心-gpu-8gb-内存-256gb-ssd-存储%2F4000447603]苹果的预算友好型 MacBook 利用 A18 Pro 处理器（该芯片最初用于 iPhone 16 Pro）来降低成本。 256GB 和 512GB 型号均配备 8GB 内存，生动的 13 英寸屏幕和扬声器给我的同事 Antonio G. Di Benedetto 留下了深刻的印象，后者比许多廉价（甚至中端）Windows 笔记本电脑的扬声器要好。 Neo 的性能并不是非常出色，尤其是在存储速度和总内存方面，但它非常适合日常任务、休闲使用和学生。阅读我们的 Apple MacBook Neo 评论。 11 月 26 日更新：调整了定价和供货情况，以反映 Amazon 和 Costco 目前提供的额外折扣。
